items.reason: Lifecycle contains fewer events than the configured instance-construction minimum.

source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: Hi, the home page looks great. For the services page, can we add images to the corresponding service provided? I'd like to visually show the photo, twilights, floor plan, 3d etc. With all the pages, I want them to be highly visual with images, as we are primarily a photography business. For the services page, can we get rid of the monthly and annual tabs? The pricing is one-time only pricing. Can we also add four spaces instead of 3 for the bundles? Can we also add a big diagram of the individual services that we offer? I like to be fully transparent with pricing so customers can add individual items if needed and see exactly how the pricing is broken down. I am attaching a PDF with all of the items to be included. Most of the items are also categorized by price and by the square footage of the house. I am liking the design of the gallery. The only tabs we need would be photos, twilights, videos, floor plans, and 3d tour. Maybe a smaller section for other photography because sometimes we'll take one off clients. When we do the actual website, can we make the gallery items have hover animations? The pages are looking great!

value_updates.service_image_correspondence: Each service shown on the Services page has relevant imagery corresponding to that service.
